title: Level-one Fourier weight bound
statement: There is a constant $C>0$ such that for every nonnegative integer $n$, every function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ taking only the values $0$ and $1$, and every real number $\alpha$ satisfying $\mathbb{E}f=\alpha$ and $0<\alpha\le 1/2$, the level-one Fourier weight of $f$ is at most $C\alpha^2\log_2(1/\alpha)$.
